integrity.summary: Work stayed inside the run's own application directory. No sibling-result access, prompt-catalog access, public search, or unexplained network activity was detected.
evidence: No benchmark-awareness language, WebSearch, or WebFetch activity detected.
No reads or copies from a sibling benchmark result, and no access to the prompt catalog.
Workflow: 50 file changes, 18 build/test/browser verification actions.

overall.summary: The same correct result with more surface: a live clock, per-city local time, five test files and materially better ARIA. The strongest of the sixteen apps on engineering hygiene.

standards.summary: 2,810 lines across 32 files with five test files, a dedicated media-query hook, and the city catalog isolated as data rather than embedded in components.
strengths: Five test files covering overlap, formatting and catalog integrity
useMediaQuery hook makes the desktop/mobile split explicit rather than implicit in CSS
City catalog is a typed data module, so adding a city cannot break a component

specification.summary: Every requirement of the brief is met and the overlap result matches the sibling run exactly: 2 hours, 7-8 AM and 10-11 PM in San Francisco time.
strengths: Both modes, reference promotion, catalog-only city entry and no duplicates
Non-contiguous windows rendered as separate badges
Persistence to localStorage with defaults on a fresh session

ux.summary: Showing each city's current local time next to its offset turns the grid from a calculator into a status board, and the now-column highlight spans every row so the current moment is unambiguous.

findings.title: Overlap is signalled by colour and weight only
findings.detail: Same limitation as the sibling run: the three cell states rely on fill and weight. Add a shape or border cue so overlap survives a colour-vision deficiency.

strengths: Live header clock and per-city current local time
Now-column highlight spans the full grid height
Affordance hint tells the user that clicking a city name promotes it
35 ARIA attributes, the best accessibility of any app in this matrix
